title: Meh
text: Meh. Clear that quality control on this product is not good.  Gets such mixed reviews from purchasers. For me, I’m one that got an extremely leaky one that doesn’t shoot a stream and doesn’t go nearly as far as advertised.  Even though no instructions came with it, I watched several youtube videos and did what adjustments I could.  Keeping the product only because the grass is bone dry and it’s fire season.  I’ll just need to drag this around more.  It looks nice though and came well-wrapped.  Y

product_metadata.title: Orbit 58308n Telescoping Tripod Sprinkler
description: The Orbit brass impact sprinkler head is constructed of heavy-duty 1/2 inch brass head that adjusts to reach up to 80 feet in radius. With partial- and full-circle coverage, its tripod base adjusts its height from 25 to 48 inches. Ideal for large lawn areas, this lawn watering impact head connects easily to any standard garden hose.
